C1765.title: Academic Research Reveals the Prevalence of Repackaging Attacks on Android Applications
C1765.summary: Researchers conducted a systematic study of six major third-party Android app markets and identified a common in-the-wild repackaging behavior: attackers obtain legitimate apps from official Android markets, repackage them, and distribute them to third-party markets.
